entries.text: `slotfather run --label` names a lease on the dashboard and in `status --json` (fathers#97).
A waiting request that loses its terminal leaves the queue at once (fathers#96).
`slotfather capabilities --json` and `status --json --full` give Godfather's dashboard its contract and snapshot (fathers#26).
The in-tree dashboard: `slotfather dashboard` points at Godfather.
`slotfather run -n K -- CMD` leases K machine slots for a command, in priority order, and hands them back when it ends.
A lease whose owner died is reaped within a second (fathers#12).
